GUIDE_INTRO: A quick tour of what you can do. Tap a title to open it.
GUIDE_PAIRING_BODY: On the home page press +, then put your device in pairing mode (see its manual). Pairing stays open for a minute. Once paired, the device shows up in the list; click its name to rename it.
GUIDE_LIGHTS_BODY: Open a device to switch it on or off, change its brightness, its color or its white. Only what the bulb supports is shown. Changes are smooth, and the list or bento layout also has quick controls on each device.
GUIDE_FX_BODY: On a bulb, the sparkles button starts an effect: a wood fire or a candle. The brightness slider sets the brightest the light gets. The effect runs on the server, so it goes on if you close the page. Any manual change of the bulb stops it.
GUIDE_SENSORS_BODY: Temperature sensors show their value live, and the battery level when they report it. Battery sensors sleep and only answer when awake: press their button just before refreshing.
GUIDE_BUTTONS_BODY: Open a button, press it, then choose what this press does: apply a scene, toggle a device or switch it on or off. Save, and it works from then on.
GUIDE_SCENES_BODY:
A scene colors the lights of a room or a group: pick the room or group, then one or more colors. The colors are spread over the lights, and you can place a given light on a given color, or switch it off.
The lights always glide to their color, at one of three speeds: slow, medium or fast. Never abrupt.
A socket has no color: choose to switch it on, switch it off, or leave it as it is.
Tick "Animated" and the lights loop through the colors, each one starting on a different color, with one brightness for all the colors. The speed is how long each color lasts: the lights glide from one to the next all the time. Any manual change of one of its lights stops it.
Apply a scene from the Scenes page, from a button, or from an automation.
GUIDE_AUTOMATIONS_BODY:
Schedules apply a scene at a given time, for example 07:30 on weekdays (in the timezone of the server).
Music mode makes the lights follow the sound of the microphone or of the system (share a tab or screen with audio). Each bulb can have several colors, and steps to the next one on each beat. It needs HTTPS or localhost to reach the microphone.
GUIDE_SETTINGS_BODY: Choose the language in Settings, and switch between day and night mode with the toggle in the header.
NO_ROOMS: No room yet. A room is a fixed zone of your home: a light belongs to one room only.
NO_GROUPS: No group yet. A group is any set of lights; a light can be in several groups.
ZONE_MOVES_HINT: In another room: it will move here
GUIDE_ZONES_BODY:
A section is a room or a group, found in the Sections page.
A room is a zone of your home (Living room, Bedroom): each light belongs to one room only. A group is any set of lights you choose (Spots, Ambient) and a light can be in several groups. Scenes can then target a room or a group.
Each room and group has, like the devices of the home page, an on/off button and a brightness slider that act on all its lights and sockets. The Whole home row at the top does the same for every light of the house.
PLACE_LIGHTS_HINT: By default the colors are spread over the lights in turn. Pick a color to place a light on it.
SCENE_NEEDS_ZONE: Create a room or a group first: a scene colors the lights of one.
ANIMATED_HINT: The lights step through the colors in a loop, each one starting on a different color. Any manual change of one of its lights stops it.
ANIMATED_NEEDS_TWO: An animated scene needs at least two colors.
SOCKETS_HINT: A socket has no color. By default the scene leaves it as it is; choose to switch it on or off when the scene starts.
ANIMATED_SAME_BRIGHTNESS: All the colors of an animated scene share this brightness: changing it while the color glides makes many bulbs stutter.
SPEED_HINT: How long the lights take to glide to their color. Always smooth, never abrupt.
SPEED_HINT_ANIMATED: How long each color lasts. The lights glide from one color to the next all the time, never abrupt.
